title.narrative: RBF programme for CCO issuance (EKN) / Capacity building component

description.narrative: Overall objective of A-GRIP: Strengthened, food secure and resilient farming systems through increased accessibility, availability and quality of land tenure security, agriculture and food security services in 16 selected districts of the Busoga, Elgon, Kigezi, Lango, and Rwenzori regions in Uganda. Objectives: ZOA leads on the CD component of A-GRIP which is designed to build capacities following a train the trainers (ToT) approach in the following areas: 1) Legal and policy framework in the land sector; 2) Land registration and technical procedures; and 3) Community awareness creation and alternative dispute resolution mechanism. These learning areas will be grounded on good practices and lessons learnt from relevant projects by the implementing partners. The good practices also entail gender and inclusive mainstreaming approaches, particularly in community sensitisation and alternative dispute resolution.
